free_tier.stated: Free tier: 5 GB per transfer (registered, free), 2 GB per transfer (Light, no registration). '1回の転送容量' is 無制限 only on the 330/550-yen business plan. The site's own headline says 無料無制限. The plan table contradicts it. No total storage: '転送容量は1回に転送できる最大容量となり、何度でもご利用いただけます'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: Retention 7 days on the free and light (no-registration) plans, 30 days on the business plan

egress.terms: No metered egress; free tiers are ad-supported, business tier is ad-free.

tooling: Web form; no API, no rclone backend.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited sends, but 7-day retention on free means chaining is strictly a re-send loop, not accumulation.
limits_note: per-object-cap 5 GB (free) / 2 GB (guest). Retention 3 days guest, 7 days free registered, 30 days business. Free tier gets throttled transfer speed (`△` vs `〇`).
